# Pulumi ComponentResource: WebApp Infrastructure

## Project structure

```
webapp/
├── Pulumi.yaml
├── __main__.py
├── components/
│   ├── __init__.py
│   └── web_app.py
├── config.py
├── Pulumi.dev.yaml
└── Pulumi.prod.yaml
```

## Pulumi.yaml

```yaml
name: webapp
runtime: python
description: Stateless web app infra (bucket, RDS, IAM)
```

## config.py

```python
import pulumi
import pulumi_aws as aws

class EnvConfig:
    def __init__(self, stack: str):
        cfg = pulumi.Config()
        self.stack = stack
        self.is_prod = stack == "prod"
        self.region = aws.get_region().name

        # Environment sizing
        if self.is_prod:
            self.db_instance_class = "db.t3.medium"
            self.db_multi_az = True
            self.db_allocated_storage = 50
            self.replication_region = "us-west-2"
            self.bucket_force_destroy = False
        else:
            self.db_instance_class = "db.t3.micro"
            self.db_multi_az = False
            self.db_allocated_storage = 20
            self.replication_region = None
            self.bucket_force_destroy = True

        # Secrets — never plaintext in git (encrypted via Pulumi secrets)
        self.db_username = cfg.require_secret("db:username")
        self.db_password = cfg.require_secret("db:password")
```

## components/web_app.py

```python
import pulumi
import pulumi_aws as aws


class WebApp(pulumi.ComponentResource):
    """Wraps S3 bucket, RDS PostgreSQL, and IAM role for service accounts."""

    def __init__(self, name: str, cfg, opts: pulumi.ResourceOptions = None):
        super().__init__("webapp:components:WebApp", name, None, opts)

        tags = {"Environment": cfg.stack, "ManagedBy": "pulumi"}

        # ── 1. S3 bucket: versioned, encrypted, no public access ──────────
        bucket = aws.s3.Bucket(
            f"{name}-assets",
            versioning=aws.s3.BucketVersioningArgs(
                enabled=True,
            ),
            server_side_encryption_configuration=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationArgs(
                rule=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationRuleArgs(
                    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default=aws
                        .s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationRuleApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefaultArgs(
                        sse_algorithm="aws:kms",
                        kms_master_key_id=aws.kms.get_key(alias="alias/aws/s3").arn,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            public_access_block=aws.s3.BucketPublicAccessBlockArgs(
                block_public_acls=True,
                block_public_policy=True,
                ignore_public_acls=True,
                restrict_public_buckets=True,
            ),
            force_destroy=cfg.bucket_force_destroy,
            tags=tags,
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )

        # Cross-region replication (prod only)
        if cfg.replication_region:
            replica = aws.s3.Bucket(
                f"{name}-assets-replica",
                bucket=f"{name}-assets-replica-{cfg.stack}",
                versioning=aws.s3.BucketVersioningArgs(enabled=True),
                tags=tags,
                opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self,
                                            provider=aws.Provider(
                                                f"{name}-replica-provider",
                                                region=cfg.replication_region)),
            )
            aws.s3.BucketReplicationConfiguration(
                f"{name}-assets-replication",
                bucket=bucket.bucket,
                role=aws.iam.Role(  # minimal replication role
                    f"{name}-replication-role",
                    assume_role_policy=aws.iam.get_policy_document(
                        statements=[aws.iam.GetPolicyDocumentStatementArgs(
                            actions=["sts:AssumeRole"],
                            principals=[aws.iam.GetPolicyDocumentStatementPrincipalArgs(
                                type="Service", identifiers=["s3.amazonaws.com"],
                            )],
                        )],
                    ).json,
                ).arn,
                rules=[aws.s3.BucketReplicationConfigurationRuleArgs(
                    status="Enabled",
                    destination=aws.s3.BucketReplicationConfigurationRuleDestinationArgs(
                        bucket=replica.arn,
                    ),
                    priority=1,
                )],
                opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
            )

        # ── 2. RDS PostgreSQL ──────────────────────────────────────────────
        subnet_group = aws.rds.SubnetGroup(
            f"{name}-db-subnets",
            subnet_ids=self._private_subnets(name, cfg),
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )

        db = aws.rds.Instance(
            f"{name}-db",
            engine="postgres",
            engine_version="16.3",
            instance_class=cfg.db_instance_class,
            allocated_storage=cfg.db_allocated_storage,
            db_name="webapp",
            username=cfg.db_username,
            password=cfg.db_password,
            db_subnet_group_name=subnet_group.name,
            multi_az=cfg.db_multi_az,
            storage_encrypted=True,
            deletion_protection=True,           # always on, both envs
            backup_retention_period=7,
            publicly_accessible=False,
            skip_final_snapshot=not cfg.is_prod,
            final_snapshot_identifier=f"{name}-db-final" if cfg.is_prod else None,
            tags=tags,
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )

        # ── 3. IAM role for service accounts (least privilege) ────────────
        assume_role = aws.iam.get_policy_document_output(
            statements=[aws.iam.GetPolicyDocumentStatementArgs(
                actions=["sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"],
                principals=[aws.iam.GetPolicyDocumentStatementPrincipalArgs(
                    type="Federated",
                    identifiers=["OIDC provider ARN injected per-cluster"],
                )],
                conditions=[{
                    "test": "StringEquals",
                    "variable": "sub",
                    "values": [f"system:serviceaccount:webapp:{name}-sa"],
                }],
            )],
        )

        role = aws.iam.Role(
            f"{name}-sa-role",
            assume_role_policy=assume_role.json,
            tags=tags,
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )

        # Least-privilege bucket access — no wildcards on prod
        bucket_actions = (
            ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject", "s3:ListBucket"]
        )
        aws.iam.RolePolicy(
            f"{name}-sa-role-policy",
            role=role.name,
            policy=pulumi.json.dumps({
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [
                    {
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": bucket_actions,
                        "Resource": [bucket.arn, pulumi.Output.concat(bucket.arn, "/*")],
                    },
                    {
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": ["rds-db:connect"],
                        "Resource": [db.arn],
                    },
                ],
            }),
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self, depends_on=[bucket, db]),
        )

        # ── Outputs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        self.bucket_name = bucket.bucket
        self.bucket_arn = bucket.arn
        self.db_endpoint = db.endpoint
        self.db_arn = db.arn
        self.role_arn = role.arn

        # Connection string as a Pulumi secret
        self.connection_string = pulumi.Output.secret(
            pulumi.Output.all(db.endpoint, cfg.db_username, cfg.db_password)
            .apply(lambda v: f"postgresql://{v[1]}:{v[2]}@{v[0]}/webapp")
        )

        self.register_outputs({
            "bucketName": self.bucket_name,
            "dbEndpoint": self.db_endpoint,
            "roleArn": self.role_arn,
        })

    def _private_subnets(self, name, cfg):
        vpc = aws.ec2.get_vpc(default=True)
        return [s.id for s in aws.ec2.get_subnet_ids(vpc_id=vpc.id).ids]


# python 3.9+ typing note: `list[str]` fine; get_vpc default shown for brevity
```

## __main__.py

```python
import pulumi
from config import EnvConfig
from components.web_app import WebApp

stack = pulumi.get_stack()
cfg = EnvConfig(stack)
app = WebApp(f"webapp-{stack}", cfg)

pulumi.export("bucket_name", app.bucket_name)
pulumi.export("db_endpoint", app.db_endpoint)
pulumi.export("role_arn", app.role_arn)
pulumi.export("connection_string", app.connection_string)  # secret
```

## Usage

```bash
pulumi config set --secret db:username admin   --stack dev
pulumi config set --secret db:password '...'   --stack dev
pulumi up --stack dev
pulumi up --stack prod
```

### How acceptance criteria are met

| Criterion | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Bucket versioning + SSE | `BucketVersioning(enabled)`, KMS SSE, full public-access block |
| RDS protection | `deletion_protection=True`, `backup_retention_period=7`, `publicly_accessible=False` |
| Secrets | `require_secret` / `Output.secret` — encrypted by Pulumi, never plaintext |
| IAM least privilege | Named actions only, no wildcards, OIDC trust with `sub` condition |
| Env isolation | Separate stacks (`dev`/`prod`) with distinct state files and config |
